dialogues.speaker: Khorin Family Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>May little Adina's dreams be forever filled with flowers and candy.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Khorin Family Grave
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Praise the courage of Danuta and Hamalainen. May they and their daughter enter a dream free from sorrow.</color>
